stories.summary: A security flaw in Grok AI enables user data to be extracted when malicious prompts are encrypted. The issue highlights risks in AI systems handling sensitive inputs without proper safeguards.
stories.title: Grok AI Vulnerability Allows Data Exfiltration via Encrypted Malicious Instructions

stories.summary: A new study introduces a method using reward-guided autoregressive graph generation to optimize communication topologies in multi-agent systems. The approach aims to improve efficiency and coordination in AI-driven collaborative networks.
stories.title: AI Researchers Develop Reward-Guided Graph Generation for Multi-Agent Communication

stories.summary: Zapier has integrated ChatGPT Work to streamline core marketing processes, improving efficiency and automation. The move highlights AI's growing role in optimizing business operations.
stories.title: Zapier Enhances Marketing Workflows with ChatGPT Work Integration

stories.summary: Circles is using OpenAI's technology to enhance personalization services for telecommunications companies. The partnership aims to improve customer experiences through advanced AI-driven solutions.
stories.title: Circles Leverages OpenAI Technology for Telco Personalization

stories.summary: Endava is utilizing Codex to develop an agentic AI framework, enhancing organizational efficiency and automation. The approach integrates AI agents to streamline workflows and decision-making processes.
stories.title: Endava Leverages Codex to Build Agentic AI Organization

stories.summary: A new method called evidence arbitration enables LLMs to detect when textual statements clash with numerical data and to reconcile these inconsistencies, boosting factual reliability. Experiments show the technique improves performance on benchmark tasks that involve contradictory information between words and numbers.
stories.title: Researchers Introduce Evidence Arbitration to Reconcile Text‑Numeric Conflicts in Large Language Models

stories.summary: Emerging AI technologies are being leveraged to enhance biodefense capabilities, marking a shift in how nations address biological threats. Intelligence agencies and researchers are increasingly integrating AI to predict, detect, and mitigate potential bioterrorism risks.
stories.title: AI Advances in Biodefense Signal New Era for National Security

stories.summary: A new update introduces advanced analytics tools and improved spending controls for enterprise AI usage. The features aim to help businesses better monitor and manage their AI expenditures.
stories.title: Enterprises Gain New AI Usage Analytics and Enhanced Spend Controls

stories.summary: A team of scientists has introduced a dynamic structural causal modeling framework that captures time‑varying causal relationships in sleep data. The method promises more accurate sleep‑stage prediction and deeper insights into the mechanisms underlying sleep disorders.
stories.title: Researchers unveil dynamic structural causal modeling technique to decode sleep patterns

stories.summary: Virgin Atlantic is leveraging ChatGPT Work to refine and personalize customer interactions. The AI tool aims to streamline journeys and improve service efficiency.
stories.title: Virgin Atlantic Enhances Customer Experience with ChatGPT Work Integration

stories.summary: New developments in AI-powered coding tools allow Codex to handle extended, complex tasks more efficiently. This breakthrough enhances productivity for developers working on long-running projects.
stories.title: AI Advances Enable Long-Running Code Generation with Codex

stories.summary: A groundbreaking approach to AI development aims to create abundant, scalable intelligence. The initiative seeks to redefine how artificial intelligence is built and deployed.
stories.title: Building Abundant Intelligence: A New AI Paradigm

stories.summary: A new approach uses simulations to forecast how AI models will perform in real-world scenarios prior to their release. This aims to reduce risks and improve reliability in AI systems.
stories.title: Researchers Develop Method to Predict AI Model Behavior Before Deployment

stories.summary: A newly discovered Mythos attack has compromised a leading post-quantum cryptography (PQC) algorithm in the third round of NIST's standardization process, rendering it ineffective. The vulnerability raises concerns about the security of PQC candidates ahead of final selection.
stories.title: Mythos Attack Disables Third-Round Post-Quantum Cryptography Candidate

stories.summary: A new AI framework, SAE-Xplainers, uses rule-based methods to interpret features in extreme earth events, enhancing scientific understanding. The approach aims to improve explainability in climate and geophysical data analysis.
stories.title: SAE-Xplainers Introduces Rule-Based AI for Interpreting Extreme Earth Events

stories.summary: A new method called EchoCoT has been developed to uncover latent reasoning processes in large language models. The approach aims to improve interpretability and performance in AI systems.
stories.title: Researchers Introduce EchoCoT to Extract Hidden Chain-of-Thought from AI Models

stories.summary: Researchers systematically evaluated a range of cache eviction strategies for large language model (LLM) inference, testing them across diverse workloads, cache capacities, and encoder architectures. The results reveal that policy X consistently outperforms alternatives under most conditions, while policy Y excels for specific encoder types and high‑memory scenarios.
stories.title: Study Finds Best Eviction Policies for Large Language Model Caches Across Workloads and Encoders

stories.summary: RingCentral is integrating AI deeply into its workflows, from engineering to operations, to enhance productivity and innovation. The move reflects a broader shift toward AI-native business processes in the tech industry.
stories.title: RingCentral Adopts AI-Native Approach Across Engineering and Operations

stories.summary: A new study examines how visual features evolve and shift across layers as Vision Transformers are trained, shedding light on the internal dynamics of these models. The findings could inform more efficient training strategies and better model interpretability.
stories.title: Researchers Uncover Feature Evolution and Migration in Vision Transformer Training

stories.summary: Emerging AI agent technologies are automating complex tasks, transforming productivity and workflows in businesses. Experts highlight their potential to streamline operations but warn of challenges in implementation and oversight.
stories.title: AI Agents Reshape Workflows Across Industries

stories.summary: OpenAI has enhanced ChatGPT with the improved GPT-5.6 Sol model and is now offering free users access to GPT-5.6 Luna. The updates aim to deliver better performance and broader availability of advanced AI capabilities.
stories.title: ChatGPT Upgrades to GPT-5.6 Sol and Expands Free Access to GPT-5.6 Luna

stories.summary: Samsung Electronics has adopted ChatGPT and Codex to enhance productivity and workflow for its employees. The move signals a growing trend of AI tool adoption in corporate environments.
stories.title: Samsung Electronics Integrates ChatGPT and Codex for Employee Use

stories.summary: OpenAI sent a letter to Texas Governor Greg Abbott advocating for policies that foster responsible AI development and infrastructure in the state. The company emphasized the need for collaboration to ensure safe and scalable AI deployment.
stories.title: OpenAI Urges Texas Governor Abbott to Support Responsible AI Infrastructure

stories.summary: New measures aim to ensure advanced AI models are developed and managed by responsible entities to mitigate risks. The initiative seeks to balance innovation with safety in the rapidly evolving AI landscape.
stories.title: Frontier AI Models to Be Placed Under Trusted Oversight

stories.summary: A firsthand account explores the challenges and insights gained from integrating AI into financial operations. The piece highlights key takeaways for organizations adopting AI-driven finance tools.
stories.title: Lessons from Building an AI-Native Finance Function

stories.summary: Researchers unveiled InsufficiencyBench, a benchmark that evaluates how large language models respond to underspecified legal queries. The study reveals notable shortcomings in current LLMs' legal advice, underscoring the need for improved evaluation and model robustness.
stories.title: New InsufficiencyBench Benchmark Tests LLMs' Ability to Provide Legal Advice on Vague Queries

stories.summary: Best Buy is running a one-day promotion where $100 gift cards will be sold for $60 at its physical stores. The discount is part of a limited-time offer aimed at driving in-store traffic.
stories.title: Best Buy Offers $100 Gift Cards for $60 In-Store This Saturday

stories.summary: Governments are increasingly adopting industrial policies to shape the development and deployment of AI technologies. This marks a shift toward strategic state intervention in the AI sector to ensure competitiveness and address societal impacts.
stories.title: Industrial Policy for the Intelligence Age

stories.summary: OpenAI is rolling out its ChatGPT Ads program to European markets, allowing businesses to advertise within the AI chatbot's interface. The expansion follows initial testing in select regions and aims to monetize the platform while enhancing user engagement.
stories.title: ChatGPT Ads Expands Across Europe

stories.summary: Hackers believed to be associated with DEF CON allegedly set up a fake Wi-Fi hotspot to target passengers on a Delta flight. The incident raises concerns about in-flight cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
stories.title: DEF CON Attendees Suspected in Fake Wi-Fi Hotspot Attack on Delta Flight

stories.summary: Media outlets are increasingly adopting AI tools to improve reporting, streamline workflows, and support their core journalistic goals. The technology is being used for tasks like data analysis, content personalization, and fact-checking.
stories.title: News Organizations Leverage AI to Enhance Journalism and Mission-Driven Work

stories.summary: The open‑source Hugging Face Transformers library has been updated to version 5.12.1, a patch release that addresses several bugs and improves overall stability. The update also includes minor performance tweaks and updated documentation for developers.
stories.title: Hugging Face releases Transformers library patch v5.12.1

stories.summary: Replit has broadened access to its AI-powered software development tools by integrating GPT-5.6 Luna. The update aims to enhance coding assistance and automation for developers.
stories.title: Replit Expands Software Creation Access with GPT-5.6 Luna

stories.summary: Preply is combining AI technology with human tutors to create a more personalized learning experience. The approach aims to enhance education by leveraging both automated tools and human expertise.
stories.title: Preply Integrates AI with Human Tutors for Personalized Learning

stories.summary: A new method called Task-CoEvolve improves AI model optimization by adaptively selecting validation tasks, enhancing efficiency. The approach aims to streamline the development of more effective AI systems.
stories.title: Researchers Introduce Task-CoEvolve for Efficient AI Harness Optimization

stories.summary: Univé is investing in upskilling its employees to prepare for AI-driven transformations. The initiative aims to enhance productivity and innovation through AI integration.
stories.title: Univé Builds an AI-Ready Workforce

stories.summary: NVIDIA is utilizing ChatGPT Work to enhance and scale its AI expertise across teams. The integration aims to streamline workflows and boost productivity in AI development.
stories.title: NVIDIA Leverages ChatGPT Work to Scale AI Expertise

stories.summary: OpenAI has unveiled an 'Ultrafast mode' for its GPT-5.6 Sol model, claiming up to 14 times faster performance. The feature aims to enhance efficiency for high-speed AI applications.
stories.title: OpenAI Previews Ultrafast Mode for GPT-5.6 Sol, Promising 14X Speed Boost

stories.summary: OpenAI has unveiled new features in ChatGPT Work and Codex designed to enhance education and training. The updates aim to streamline learning processes and improve teaching efficiency with AI assistance.
stories.title: ChatGPT Work and Codex Introduce New AI-Powered Learning and Teaching Tools

stories.summary: Researchers demonstrate the application of Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to new AI domains beyond conversational agents. The method, originally for chatbots, now shows promise in broader machine learning tasks.
stories.title: Direct Preference Optimization Expands Beyond Chatbots

stories.summary: A new guide details the capabilities and implementation of GPT-5.6, offering developers insights into the latest AI model. The document likely includes technical specifications, use cases, and best practices for integration.

stories.summary: The evolution of AI is reshaping software design, moving beyond traditional three-tier architecture to a new paradigm centered on storage, models, and autonomous agents. This marks the third major restructuring in software form, reflecting the growing influence of AI systems.
stories.title: AI Drives Shift in Software Architecture: From Three-Tier to Storage, Models, and Agents

stories.summary: The Transformers.js library is testing a new Cross-Origin Storage API to enhance cross-origin data access for AI models. This development aims to improve performance and security in web-based AI applications.
stories.title: Transformers.js Experiments with Proposed Cross-Origin Storage API

stories.summary: A new approach enables AI models to decide dynamically how much computation to expend for each input, improving efficiency without sacrificing accuracy. The technique, termed adaptive reasoning for test‑time compute allocation, was detailed in a recent research paper and shows promise for broader deployment in resource‑constrained settings.
stories.title: Researchers Develop Adaptive Reasoning Method to Allocate Compute at Test Time

stories.summary: OpenAI has introduced the OpenAI Partner Network, a new initiative to foster collaboration with businesses and developers. The program aims to accelerate AI adoption and innovation through strategic partnerships.
stories.title: OpenAI Launches Partner Network to Expand AI Collaboration

stories.summary: A new version of ChatGPT tailored for academic researchers aims to speed up scientific breakthroughs. The tool is designed to assist with literature reviews, data analysis, and hypothesis generation.
stories.title: ChatGPT Launched for Academic Researchers to Accelerate Scientific Discovery

stories.summary: Businesses are integrating ChatGPT Work to streamline sales processes, enhancing efficiency and productivity. The AI tool assists with tasks like lead qualification, follow-ups, and data analysis.
stories.title: Sales Teams Adopt ChatGPT Work for Workflow Automation

stories.summary: Researchers have released AI4AI‑Bench, a new suite of tasks that evaluates large language model agents on algorithmic design problems aimed at recursive self‑improvement. The benchmark provides standardized metrics to compare how effectively LLMs can generate, analyze, and iteratively refine code that enhances their own capabilities.
stories.title: AI4AI‑Bench Introduces Benchmark for Testing LLM Agents on Recursive Self‑Improvement Algorithms

stories.summary: OpenAI has introduced enhanced features to GPT-Rosalind, its AI model for biological research. The update aims to improve accuracy and efficiency in genomic and molecular analysis.

stories.summary: The initiative aims to leverage AI to propel scientific discovery and innovation at a national scale. It underscores the role of artificial intelligence in shaping the future of research and development.
stories.title: Advancing the Next Era of National Science with AI
